title: TradingBot committed fill notification 1.0
description: An event for one committed fill. The UTF-8 JSON message is limited to 4096 bytes and duplicate keys are forbidden.

id.description: Stable fill ID unique across modes and accounts. Each separately recorded partial fill has a distinct ID.

source.description: Optional simulated-exchange marker restricted to paper events on the fixture topic.

instrument_id.description: Canonical instrument identity, including any venue or registry namespace needed to distinguish it.

price.description: Execution price per unit in the specified currency.

currency.description: Currency or quote asset display code.

filled_at.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp with at most nine fractional digits.

PositiveDecimal.description: Positive exact decimal with up to 38 whole and 18 fractional digits.
